decisions.reason: As a 2023 extension of the established spraying business that remained on the website in 2024, it likely meets at least modest aspiration levels and a medium-sized R&D-oriented firm in a growing industry has enough slack to continue it.

Its own product page in both 2023 and 2024 and the move from test phase to marketed offer indicate satisfactory progress for a close-to-core product, reducing pressure for problemistic search away from it.
This line builds directly on proven air motors and was still marketed in 2024, so its strong fit with existing capabilities and product-family logic makes withdrawal unlikely.

Although somewhat more adjacent than the pump and spraying products, it had dedicated website presence across both years and also supports the firm's move toward more digitalized customer solutions, favoring retention.

Because it was only launched in 2024 there is less performance evidence and more uncertainty, but its close relation to the established offer and the firm's organizational slack still make continued market presence more likely than withdrawal.
